headline: LAD @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 5.41 at CHW 4.02, with a projected total of 9.43. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: LAD moved +1.13 runs while CHW moved +0.54, changing the projected margin by +0.59 runs. The projected total climbed +1.68, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -11.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Roki Sasaki has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Chase Meidroth, Andy Pages, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Alex Call because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
